title: microcos lanceolata
intro: Microcos lanceolata, commonly known as the "Purple Pasque Flower" or "Yellow Pasque Flower" in different regions, is a flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exerting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Microcos lanceolata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are primarily due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Microcos lanceolata contribute to its potential therapeutic uses in treating various conditions, including infections, allergies, and skin disorders.
